reviews.comment: STAT-211. Very friendly and relaxed. Freebie attendance quizzes every Friday, posts all lectures, notes, and slides on canvas. Homeworks are comparatively short (takes about an hour to an hour and a half at most every week) and is helpful for the exam. Lectures can get a bit confusing and long sometimes, but prof. James explains topics well.

Honestly had a hard time understanding the professor, better to study independently using the lecture slides. The class is test heavy, but if you complete all the homework on time, you should be fine. The final and quizzes were easier than expected. Overall the class itself is manageable if you stay focused and avoid cramming the day before exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a great guy, but he be telling me to much stories (great for many but prob not for very blunt people like me) . Hell give surprise quizes here and there which is one thing I would take away from his curriculum, but he knows what he is talking about. Gets lost in the syllabus and decelerates/accelerates randomly on topics, but is manageable.

Took him for STATS 302, he was an amazing prof!! He's lectures were funny but do be prepared to teach yourself outside of class. 7 homework chapters, several video quiz, extra credits, 2 midterm exams on computer and 1 final exam with a front and back cheat sheet. Easiest prof for stats course.

Took for STAT 302. He is a great person and wants his students to succeed. The class is difficult but he made it as easy as he could. Common exams with all sections for two midterms which were very difficult. The final exactly the final review he gave us with different numbers. We got 3% added to our average for completing the final exam review.

seems so easy (you get a cheat sheet on all the exams), that you barely try but after the first exam its more difficult. there are only 2 exams plus final. Professor james was alright, he was never really prepared for lecture and he overexplained to the point where something easy seemed difficult. hes a great guy though, very chill and laid back.
